scheme_name: Chief Ministergi Artistessingi Tengbang - Assistance To The Cultural Group For Training With New Production
description:
The Chief Ministergi Artistessingi Tengbang scheme was launched by the Government of Manipur on 25th December 2020. 

This initiative aims to provide financial assistance to cultural groups and artists in Manipur. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to promote and preserve the rich cultural heritage of Manipur through various artistic expressions. 

The scheme specifically targets cultural groups that engage in traditional arts, crafts, and performances. 

It aims to enhance the skills of artists and cultural practitioners by providing them with training and resources for new productions. 

The government has set measurable targets to ensure that at least 1,000 artists benefit from this scheme annually. 

The scheme also aims to facilitate the creation of at least 200 new cultural productions each year. 

Financial assistance under this scheme can go up to INR 1 lakh per cultural group. 

This amount is intended to cover training costs, production expenses, and other related activities. 

Eligible cultural groups must consist of at least 5 members. 

The members of the group should primarily be residents of Manipur. 

The age limit for applicants is set at a minimum of 18 years. 

There is no upper age limit specified for applicants. 

The income criteria for eligibility stipulate that the combined annual income of the group members should not exceed INR 5 lakh. 

Cultural groups must also demonstrate a history of engagement in cultural activities for at least three years. 

To apply for the scheme, cultural groups must submit a detailed project proposal. 

This proposal should outline the training program and the intended production. 

Groups must also provide a list of members along with their identification documents. 

The application must include proof of residence for each member. 

Additionally, groups need to submit a certificate of registration if they are formally registered. 

The application process is conducted online through the official Manipur government portal. 

Applicants must create an account on the portal to access the application form. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by a designated committee. 

The committee will evaluate the proposals based on their cultural significance and feasibility. 

Successful applicants will receive the financial assistance within 30 days of approval. 

The disbursement of funds will be made directly to the bank accounts of the cultural groups. 

The scheme is expected to be reviewed annually to assess its impact and effectiveness. 

Feedback from beneficiaries will be collected to improve the scheme further. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Department of Art and Culture, Government of Manipur. 

The department can be contacted for any queries related to the scheme. 

The contact details for the Department of Art and Culture are available on the official Manipur government website. 

The scheme also aims to foster collaboration between different cultural groups. 

It encourages groups to work together on joint productions and training programs. 

This collaborative approach is intended to enhance the overall quality of cultural outputs in the state. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 5 crore for the first year of implementation. 

This budget is expected to increase in subsequent years based on the scheme's success. 

The scheme also aims to promote cultural tourism in Manipur. 

By enhancing the skills of local artists, the government hopes to attract more tourists interested in cultural experiences. 

The scheme aligns with the larger vision of the Government of India to promote the arts and culture sector. 

It also complements other initiatives aimed at skill development and employment generation in the creative industries. 

The Chief Ministergi Artistessingi Tengbang scheme is part of a broader strategy to empower local communities through cultural engagement. 

The government recognizes the importance of culture in fostering social cohesion and community identity. 

By investing in cultural training and production, the scheme aims to create sustainable livelihoods for artists. 

The scheme also emphasizes the need for innovation in traditional art forms. 

It encourages artists to experiment with new techniques and mediums. 

This approach is intended to keep the cultural practices relevant in a rapidly changing world. 

The scheme is expected to have a positive impact on the local economy. 

By supporting cultural groups, the government aims to stimulate economic activity in related sectors. 

These sectors include tourism, hospitality, and local crafts. 

The scheme is also seen as a way to combat the challenges posed by globalization. 

By strengthening local cultural identities, the government hopes to mitigate the effects of cultural homogenization. 

The Chief Ministergi Artistessingi Tengbang scheme represents a significant step towards recognizing the value of culture in development. 

It highlights the government's commitment to supporting the arts and ensuring that cultural heritage is preserved for future generations. 

The scheme is a testament to the belief that culture plays a crucial role in nation-building. 

By empowering artists and cultural groups, the government aims to foster a sense of pride and ownership among the people of Manipur. 

The scheme is expected to create a vibrant cultural landscape in the state. 

This will not only benefit artists but also enrich the lives of the community as a whole. 

In conclusion, the Chief Ministergi Artistessingi Tengbang scheme is a comprehensive initiative aimed at supporting cultural groups in Manipur. 

With specific financial assistance and a clear framework for eligibility and application, the scheme seeks to promote artistic expression and cultural heritage. 

The government's commitment to this scheme reflects a broader understanding of the importance of culture in society. 

Through this initiative, Manipur aims to nurture its artistic talents and preserve its unique cultural identity.
